value.rationale: This is a natural complete first-order classification of all growth regimes for a concrete family of independent random expansions of finite base structures: it proves a necessary-and-sufficient criterion, a countably indexed hierarchy of two-dimensional Poisson critical laws, and a nonconvergence mechanism arising solely from a random unary predicate while every deterministic reduct satisfies a zero-one law. Exact conditional probabilities and the two-sided EF invariant make the result useful as a baseline for random-expansion convergence.
